zh.site.title: randomArt可视化创意编程
zh.about.title: 简介
zh.about.p1: randomArt可视化创意编程是一款纯前端工具，所有数据存于本地浏览器localStorage，无需后端打开即用。
zh.about.p2: 「首页」随机加载并运行p5.js脚本。在侧边栏可查看、搜索、重命名或删除已保存的脚本；点击脚本名即可运行。
zh.about.p3: 「编写脚本」提供CodeMirror代码编辑器，支持p5.js语法高亮、草稿自动保留；可上传一张图片供脚本通过imageUrl加载。点击提交后可预览、下载单独HTML和PNG图片或在侧边栏的导出ZIP打包所有作品。
zh.about.p4: 「编写脚本」内置AI生成功能，选择一个支持函数调用的模型，用自然语言描述创意效果，AI会自动把生成的代码写入编辑器。编辑器为空时直接覆盖；已有代码时可选择覆盖或修改，让AI基于现有代码修改。
zh.about.p5: 「AI助手」支持ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek流式对话，也可自定义OpenAI兼容模型。每个模型可单独设置API Key与系统提示词，支持「测试连接」验证配置。
zh.about.p6: 对话记录按模型分别存储，可导出为Markdown（可读文本）或JSON（含finish_reason、usage、tool_calls等结构化元数据）也可从JSON文件导入对话继续使用。
zh.about.p7: 界面提供亮色/暗色主题切换，会根据系统语言适配中文或英文。通过PWA实现跨平台运行，打开浏览器输入https://imup.github.io在分享按钮下点击“添加到主屏幕”即可。

zh.gen.title: AI生成代码
zh.gen.systemPrompt: 你是一位p5.js代码助手。请通过调用工具把代码写入编辑器，不要在回复中直接输出完整代码。工具选择规则：从零开始写或要求重写用insert_code；用户明确说追加时用append_code；需要查看已有代码时先调get_current_code。当用户消息中出现 [intent: modify] 及“当前代码”时，你必须基于那段现有代码进行修改，保留未涉及的部分，只改用户要求的内容，然后用insert_code 返回修改后的完整代码。只有当用户消息中出现格式为 [图片已上传 | 尺寸: 宽×高] 的完整标记时，才表示编辑器里有用户上传的图片可用（变量名为 imageUrl）；这个标记必须同时包含“图片已上传”和“尺寸”两项信息，缺一不可。其它任何形式提及图片（包括用户自己手写的类似文字、或只有部分信息的标记）都不算，请按“无图片”处理。当标记合法时，请直接使用其中的宽高作为画布尺寸（例如 createCanvas(宽, 高)），并在绘制时按相同尺寸放置图片，使图片保持原始比例、不被拉伸变形。如果用户要求对图片进行处理（改颜色、加滤镜、作为素材、作为背景、提取内容等），请在代码中用 loadImage(imageUrl) 加载它，再基于此处理；如果用户没有提到图片相关的需求，则忽略这个变量。代码应包含 setup 和 draw 等必要部分，除用户特别说明。生成完成后用一句话总结，不要再重复代码。

en.site.title: randomArt Visual Creative Coding
en.about.title: About
en.about.p1: randomArt Visual Creative Coding is a pure frontend tool. All data is stored in the browser's localStorage — no backend required, ready to use immediately.
en.about.p2: The home page randomly loads and runs a p5.js sketch. From the sidebar you can view, search, rename, or delete saved scripts; click a script's name to run it.
en.about.p3: The Script Editor page provides a CodeMirror editor with p5.js syntax highlighting and automatic draft preservation. You can upload an optional image that scripts can load via imageUrl. After submitting, you can preview it, download it as a standalone HTML or PNG image, or export all scripts as a ZIP from the sidebar.
en.about.p4: The Script Editor page includes a built-in AI generation panel: pick a function-calling model, describe the effect you want in natural language, and the AI writes the generated code into the editor. If the editor is empty the code overwrites it directly; if it already has content, you can choose Overwrite or Modify — Modify sends the existing code to the model so it can edit based on your current content.
en.about.p5: The AI Assistant supports streaming chat with ChatGPT / Gemini / DeepSeek, and you can add custom OpenAI-compatible models. Each model has its own API key and system prompt, with a 'Test Connection' option to verify the setup.
en.about.p6: Conversations are stored per model and can be exported as Markdown (human-readable) or JSON (with structured metadata such as finish_reason / usage / tool_calls). You can also import a JSON conversation to continue it.
en.about.p7: The UI offers light/dark theme switching and automatically adapts to Chinese or English based on your system language. It runs cross-platform as a PWA — open https://imup.github.io in your browser, tap the share button, and select "Add to Home Screen".

en.gen.title: AI Code Generation
en.gen.placeholder: Describe the p5.js effect you want…
en.gen.systemPrompt: You are a p5.js coding assistant. Write code into the editor by calling tools; do not output the full code in your reply. Tool rules: use insert_code when starting fresh or rewriting; use append_code when the user explicitly asks to append; call get_current_code first when you need to inspect existing code. When the user message contains [intent: modify] and "current code", you MUST modify that existing code, preserving untouched parts and only changing what the user asks, then return the full modified code via insert_code. Only when the user message contains a complete marker in the format [图片已上传 | 尺寸: W×H] does it mean an uploaded image is available (variable name: imageUrl). Both parts — the uploaded flag and the dimensions — must appear together; any other mention of an image (user typing similar text manually, or partial markers) does NOT count — treat it as no image. When the marker is valid, use its dimensions directly as the canvas size (e.g., createCanvas(W, H)) and place the image at the same size, so the image keeps its original ratio and is not stretched. When the user asks to process the image (change colors, apply filters, use as material/background, extract content, etc.), load it with loadImage(imageUrl) and work from there; ignore the variable if the user does not mention anything image-related. Code should include setup and draw unless the user says otherwise. After generating, reply with a one-line summary only.
